verdict.rationale: pnpm's docs call it a "drop-in replacement for npm" that works on any existing project with "no migration, no rewrites". Its commands mirror npm conventions: `pnpm install`, `pnpm audit` / `pnpm audit --fix`, `pnpm config set` and `pnpm licenses list`. Users report smooth switches from yarn, lerna and npm, but some behaviour diverges from the incumbent: peer dependencies are not auto-installed, and some packages needed `--shamefully-hoist`. Missing for 10: a documented npm/yarn-to-pnpm command mapping, independent hands-on confirmation of command parity, and full parity on behaviours like auto-installing peer dependencies.
